The 2024 GMC Terrain Denali in white frost tricoat delivers a refined driving experience with premium features and thoughtful design that makes every journey more enjoyable. This one-owner vehicle with a clean CARFAX and excellent service history provides the confidence you want when choosing a pre-owned luxury compact SUV.

- All Wheel Drive
- Heated Leather Seats with Ventilation
- Moonroof with Power Sunscreen
- Backup Camera with Surround Vision
- Blind Spot Monitors
- Bluetooth Connectivity
- Premium 7-Speaker Bose Sound System
- GMC Infotainment with Navigation
- Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- 8-Way Power Driver Seat with Lumbar
- 6-Way Power Front Passenger Seat
- Adaptive Cruise Control
- Automatic Parking Assist
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Power Liftgate

Powered by a 1.5L DOHC engine with nine-speed automatic transmission and all-wheel drive, this Terrain delivers 23 city and 28 highway MPG for balanced efficiency. The interior reflects the Denali nameplate's commitment to quality, featuring heated and ventilated leather seats with power adjustment including lumbar support on both driver and passenger sides. The expansive Skyscape power sunroof with retractable sunscreen fills the cabin with natural light and fresh air.

Technology comes standard with the GMC Infotainment system, featuring navigation and connected services. Wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto keep you seamlessly connected to your devices, while the SiriusXM-ready AM/FM radio with seven speaker Bose audio system delivers quality sound for your commute or road trip. Multiple USB data ports ensure your devices stay charged throughout the day.

Safety and convenience features round out this comprehensive package. The automatic parking assist helps you navigate tight spaces with confidence, while the backup camera with surrounding vision gives you a clear view behind you. Blind spot monitors provide additional awareness, and adaptive cruise control reduces driver fatigue on long drives. Automatic high-beam headlights and front fog lights enhance visibility in various conditions.

This Terrain Denali is equipped for the demands of modern driving with dual-zone automatic temperature control, power windows, power door mirrors with heating, and a power liftgate for easy cargo access. The all-wheel-drive system provides enhanced traction and stability, while the fog lights and equipped suspension contribute to confident handling. The Denali Premium Package includes comfort and technology elements that elevate the ownership experience.

The 19-inch bright machined aluminum wheels and body-color bumpers complete a sophisticated exterior appearance. Whether you prioritize comfortable daily driving, technology integration, or all-weather capability, this 2024 GMC Terrain Denali meets those expectations with demonstrated reliability and premium appointments. We invite you to schedule a time to see this vehicle in our showroom.

- Essex AP Racing big brake kit w/ Ferodo & Carbotech pads available
- Several engine & fueling overhead modifications
- Chassis bushings/lockdowns/braces, steering lockdown, transmission & shifter upgrades.
- Fresh fluids (<1000 mi) in engine, transmission, differential, and radiator.
- Flex-fuel system installed and tuned by Ron Watson @ Phatbotti Tuning with valet tune included (I have a burble tune but recommend not using those sorts of tunes as they're awful for your cats & the car in general).

Can include like-new lightweight Konig Dekagrams with slicks mounted and balanced for $1,000 in addition to list price or offer.

description:
This K2500 LT model Suburban is an oldy but goody that'll still tow the Queen Mary if asked nicely....or at least up to 12,000 lbs, which it's done and in comfort with its leather seats that, except for the driver's seat, are still in very nice condition. And there's no reason that it wouldn't do it now because, even though it's got high mileage, (316,834) 95% of that was towing vintage trailers up and down freeways the length of CA, Oregon and Nevada. It's also partly because I not only used Mobil-1 synthetic oil religiously, but had it changed every 5k-6k miles and also had the transmission and filter changed every six months, that is until the Great Recession ruined everything. So, for the last 10 years or so it's only driven it periodically, which is why I decided to sell it.

So, here's the low down on, first, what works on this completely drivable vehicle:
Pretty much everything, including....All of the electric windows, the electric front seats, the mirrors, all of the lights, the entire 4-wheel drive system, the original motor and transmission, the brakes, all of the gauges (yes, it has gauges, not idiot lights) and even the windshield wipers.

Now, here's what doesn't work, needs work or needs to be replaced:
It needs a new a/c compressor, the catalytic converter has been stolen and needs to be replaced, the windshield rubber sealant needs replacing and, while I'm at it, maybe the windshield. The driver's seat needs to be reupholstered, the driver's side interior door handle and the rear door handle need to be replaced, but replacement units come with the truck, as does a billet aluminum, adjustable trailer hitch along with a box of body mount bushings that I never installed. As you can see in the photos, it has a few minor dents here and there and also needs a paint job, but that's pretty much it. And, as you can also see in the photos, I have a folder with TEN YEARS OF REPAIR AND SERVICE RECORDS.

description: Congratulations! You've found your way to an ad for the most glorious SUV known to mankind. There's a reason that you always see these in presidential motorcades, because they're luxurious, hold lots of people, and you have to be an absolute boss to own one. The pictures don't do it justice. Epic space in this thing! It's like Mary Poppins's purse but in vehicle form! Are you a soccer mom but not ready to commit to the minivan yet? Neither was I! Unfortunately, rides this plush usually come with plush price tags too, and I can no longer afford to drive it, c'est la vie, no? But my financial situation might not look like yours, my loss = your gain. This truck is loaded with primo features and it's been great for carrying our family of 9 to lots of extra curriculars, low miles tho!  Not completely murdered out, but it does have black GMC emblems and smoked side markers instead of the fugly orange ones. The only thing wrong with this beast is a small crack in the windshield that literally happened like 3 weeks ago, curse you Murphy and your stupid Law!!! Fortunately, however, this vehicle comes with a bulletproof, transferable third party warranty that covers full replacement of said windshield for free, I've already checked. The only reason I haven't done it yet is because the glass takes like two weeks to come in, and I want to go ahead and sell this thing because I've already purchased my next, cheaper, not so awesome ride...  (*wipes tears from face *).  Dealers, sorry; the warranty doesn't transfer to you, but, if you want to order the glass and do the windshield replacement I will set up the claim through you, (you could even potentially profit from this). Anyways, thanks for taking a look at my baby, I am truly going to miss her. Have an amazing day and God bless!

The Ranger's technology package delivers modern conveniences with navigation, adaptive cruise control, and forward sensing system to keep you connected and confident on every journey. Dual-zone automatic climate control, power-adjustable windows, and an illuminated entry system enhance daily usability. The SYNC 3 system with emergency communication support through 911 Assist connects you to help when needed.

Safety features throughout the truck include dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, electronic stability control, and traction control. The low tire pressure warning system and security system provide additional layers of protection for you and your investment.

This 2022 Ford Ranger XLT represents a practical investment for buyers seeking truck capability without compromise. Its balanced approach to work, recreation, and daily driving makes it a versatile choice. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this truck firsthand and discuss how it fits your needs.

Certified Vehicle!

This 2019 GMC Sierra 1500 SLT in white combines capable truck performance with refined comfort and modern conveniences. Whether you're managing daily responsibilities or tackling weekend projects, this Sierra delivers the reliability and features you need in a full-size pickup.

The integrated trailer brake controller and in-vehicle trailering app make towing management straightforward.

This certified vehicle meets rigorous quality standards, backed by a clean Carfax report and one-owner history. Certification includes a 1-month or 1,000-mile limited powertrain warranty, providing assurance in your purchase. All four wheel locks and a complete spare tire are included. With its blend of capability, comfort, and modern features, this Sierra 1500 SLT is ready to serve as your dependable truck partner.

This 2021 Ford Transit-250 Base in white represents a solid work platform built to handle demanding daily tasks. With a V6 engine paired to a 10-speed automatic transmission, this van delivers the capability you need for commercial or personal hauling. The rear-wheel-drive configuration provides stability when carrying loads, while the limited-slip axle ratio ensures confident traction in various conditions.

The Transit-250 prioritizes driver comfort and control. The vinyl front bucket seats provide a comfortable perch during long workdays, while the telescoping and tilt steering wheel allows you to find your ideal driving position. Power-assisted steering and full power windows make everyday operation effortless, and cruise control with adjustable speed limiting lets you maintain consistent speeds on highway routes.

Visibility is enhanced through multiple design features. The fixed rear cargo door glass allows you to monitor your cargo without opening the doors, while the rear-window defroster clears condensation quickly. Front fog lamps cut through poor visibility conditions, and the exterior parking camera rear provides added awareness when backing into tight spaces.

Access and storage have been thoughtfully integrated into this work van's design. The 50/50 hinged rear doors open to 253 degrees, providing wide access to the cargo area for loading and unloading. D-pillar assist handles on both driver and passenger sides make climbing in and out convenient, especially when carrying equipment. Vinyl floor covering front and rear resists wear and cleans easily after messy jobs.

Safety features are comprehensive. Electronic stability control and traction control help maintain grip during acceleration or in slippery conditions, while dual front impact air bags and dual front side impact airbags provide occupant protection. ABS brakes with brake assist give you confident stopping power, and the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed about tire condition.

This Transit-250 is ready to earn its keep as a dependable work companion. With its straightforward feature set and proven Ford reliability, it provides the foundation for productivity.
